profile_text.body:
Lokalise describes itself as a continuous localization and translation management platform that integrates into a development workflow so teams can ship localized products. The company says the platform connects workflows and standardizes execution in one system, and that it uses AI to deliver consistent, on-brand experiences across markets. It also describes applying role-based access control across the platform and its API, with API access using the same model as the web interface.

Its tracked product is Lokalise AI, listed under search, research, translation and other tools, and described as localization AI for continuous translation in developer workflows, hosted in the UK. Per the company, the AI applies approved terminology, tone of voice and vocabulary to keep translations consistent with a brand across languages, and uses Custom AI Profiles, surrounding context and metadata to preserve meaning. Lokalise says AI Scoring evaluates translation quality automatically so that only low-confidence results need human review, and that the platform dynamically selects and routes to the best-fit LLM based on language, content and context without repeated configuration. The site also carries editorial content on AI translation tools, including a test of ten such tools, and states that AI translation tools cannot fully replace human translators.

Company facts on record give a founding year of 2016 and a headquarters in Newark, Delaware, in the United States. Legal exposure recorded for the company is in Delaware, with a count of 33.
